name: Level_2 - Task_7
description: Evaluate the volumetric thermal expansion of bulk Aluminum (Al) between 300 K and 500 K using molecular dynamics and linear regression. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model, loaded from the local path ./models/2023-12-03-mace-128-L1_epoch-199.model, as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe the interatomic interactions. Start by generating a bulk conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Aluminum with a lattice parameter a = 4.05 Å, and replicate it into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell. Perform NPT molecular dynamics simulations at three target temperatures: 300 K, 400 K, and 500 K, using an external pressure of 1.01325 bar. For each temperature, equilibrate the system for 5,000 MD steps using an appropriate NPT integrator with a timestep of 1.0 fs, a thermostat time constant of 25 fs, and a barostat factor of 2e6 GPa × fs². Follow the equilibration with 10,000 production steps under the same NPT conditions. During production, record the instantaneous cell volume every 10 MD steps and calculate the average production-phase volume for each temperature. Using the three average volumes at 300 K, 400 K, and 500 K, perform a linear regression of volume versus temperature to obtain the slope dV/dT. Calculate the volumetric coefficient of thermal expansion as β = (1 / V_300) × (dV/dT), where V_300 is the average volume at 300 K. Return the resulting coefficient β as a floating-point value in K⁻¹.
